facts.text: Final cloud migration phase handles record links and notes migration, disables cloud migration, runs API data upgrade, sets up users, maps user accounts, and reconfigures integrations.
Migrate record links and notes from buffer table to actual table via Migrate Record Links and Notes action on Cloud Migration Management page.
Disable cloud migration by selecting Complete Cloud, reading checklist information, toggling acknowledgment switch, then selecting Disable Cloud Migration and confirming.
Run API data upgrade by opening Cloud Migration Management, selecting Manage API Upgrade, choosing company, scheduling job queue entry for entities reset.
Integration runtime remains installed after disabling cloud migration; cloud registration auto-cleans after 2 weeks of non-use if not used again.
User accounts and permissions from Business Central on-premises are not migrated; each on-premises user requires new Microsoft 365 account with Business Central license.
External integrations and services must be updated to reflect new environment URL and Microsoft Entra Tenant ID after migration.
User mappings can only execute once per environment and should be run as final step; test in sandbox before applying to production.
